zrodlo: Rola 04, fix NZ-P217-04 (P-217, P-218, P-220). Nakłada 08: node docs/design/narzedzia/nakladaj-klucze-fix7.mjs. Liczba mnoga: _one/_other w en, kontekst pod kluczem bazowym. Grupa W zawiera 25 kluczy znacznika z design-spec (fix NZ-08-P2-04), dotąd poza słownikiem (N1); grupy R i I: rozszerzenie, skrzynka, iCloud.

en.wzor.kierunek_pytanie: Which way do rows go on this page?
en.wzor.kierunek_stan_gora: Rows go up, like a chart
en.wzor.kierunek_stan_dol: Rows go down, like written steps
en.wzor.koniec_strony_gora: Row {{n}} is past the top of page {{strona}}
en.wzor.koniec_strony_dol: Row {{n}} is past the bottom of page {{strona}}
en.wzor.koniec_strony_opis: Move the marker to row {{n}} on the next page.
en.wzor.koniec_wzoru: Row {{n}} is past the end of the pattern.
en.wzor.znacznik_a11y_gora: Row marker, row {{n}}, rows go up
en.wzor.znacznik_a11y_dol: Row marker, row {{n}}, rows go down
en.wzor.notatka_bez_znacznika: A note sits next to a row.
en.wzor.notatka_zaznacz: Mark the row on the pattern first, then write the note.
en.wzor.dodaj_opis: PDF, Word, a photo of a page or a web page
en.wzor.link_opis: Oczko saves the page as it looks now, so it opens without the internet.
en.wzor.link_blad: That doesn’t look like a web link. Check it and try again.
en.wzor.film_opis: Oczko keeps only the link. The video opens in your browser and needs the internet.
en.wzor.usun_opis: The pattern and its highlights and drawings are deleted. Row notes and counters stay. This can’t be undone.
en.wzor.zakreslacz_podpowiedz: Drag a finger to highlight. Two fingers scroll.
en.wzor.rysik_podpowiedz: The pencil writes. Your finger scrolls.
en.wzor.czeka_siec: Waiting for the internet to save the web page.
en.wzor.blad_plik_opis: “{{plik}}” may be damaged. Nothing was added. Download or save it again, then add it.
en.wzor.blad_typ: Oczko can’t add this type of file
en.wzor.blad_typ_opis: Patterns can be PDFs, Word documents, photos or web pages. Nothing was added.
en.wzor.blad_rozmiar_opis: A pattern can be up to {{mb}} MB. Nothing was added.
en.wzor.blad_strona_opis: The page asks you to sign in, or it has no text or pictures. Nothing was added. Open it in your browser, save it as a PDF and add the PDF.
en.wzor.brak_aparatu_opis: To scan pattern pages, allow camera access in Settings. You can still choose photos or a file.
en.wzor.word_podglad: Word documents open as they are. To mark rows and highlight, save it as a PDF and add the PDF.
en.udostepnij.gotowe: It’ll be in {{projekt}} next time you open Oczko.
en.udostepnij.gotowe_nowy: It’ll be in a new project next time you open Oczko.
en.udostepnij.kolejny: {{projekt}} already has a pattern. This one is added next to it, and you can switch between them.
en.udostepnij.bez_migawki: Oczko will ask which project it’s for when you open it.
en.udostepnij.za_duzy: A pattern can be up to {{mb}} MB, so Oczko can’t add this file.
en.udostepnij.nieobslugiwany: Patterns can be PDFs, Word documents, photos or web pages.
en.skrzynka.uszkodzony: It may be damaged. Download or save it again, then add it.
en.icloud.opis: Keeps projects, patterns and history the same on your devices. Your data goes only to your own iCloud; Oczko has no server.
en.icloud.wlacz_opis: Projects on this iPhone and those already in your iCloud are combined. Nothing is deleted. If a counter has different values, Oczko shows both and you choose.
en.icloud.wylacz_opis: Everything stays on this iPhone. Changes here stop going to iCloud, and your other devices keep what they have.
en.icloud.brak_konta_opis: Check that you’re signed in to iCloud and that iCloud is on for Oczko in Settings. Everything stays saved on this iPhone.
en.icloud.brak_miejsca_opis: Changes aren’t syncing. They’re saved on this iPhone and will sync when there’s space.
en.icloud.konto_zmienione_opis: This iPhone is now signed in to another iCloud account. Sync is paused and your data here is unchanged. Sync with this account? Your projects here and in that account are combined.
en.icloud.konflikt_opis: {{lokalna}} rows here, {{zdalna}} from {{urzadzenie}}. Choose the one that matches your knitting.
en.icloud.konflikt_wybor_opis: Pick the one that matches your knitting. The other stays in the history.
en.icloud.niepelna: Some changes from your other devices aren’t shown yet
en.icloud.niepelna_nowsza: They come from a newer version of Oczko. Update Oczko on this iPhone to see them. Your counters here are unchanged.
en.icloud.niepelna_opis: Oczko keeps trying. Your counters here are unchanged.
en.icloud.zastap_wylacz_opis: To replace what’s here, iCloud sync needs to be off. Otherwise iCloud would bring the old data back. You can turn it on again afterwards.
en.icloud.usun_z_icloud_opis: Your other devices lose these projects the next time they sync.
en.icloud.usun_zostaje: Data in iCloud and on your other devices stays.
